name: glitch
title: Glitch
description: On hover, focus or tap, the word tears for a moment: two offset colour copies slip sideways in thin bands, then it settles. Never loops.

meta.useWhen: The concept is a broken signal, a corrupted file, a jump cut or an error that matters; one word or a short label.
meta.avoidWhen: Body text; anything that must be read during the effect; brands that want calm; more than one per page.
